evals.prompt: A support agent runs models, retrieval, address updates, human approvals and retries. Operators only see "started" and "done". Specify event fields and an example timeline that reconstructs a lost mutation response followed by resume, with outcome/cost/latency metrics and privacy controls.
evals.expected_output: Joined, bounded and privacy-aware trajectory events.
expectations: Uses stable run/operation IDs plus separate attempts, correlation and state versions.
Links approval/policy, mutation receipt, checkpoint/resume and evaluator outcome.
Records model/tool/prompt/policy versions and unknown outcome distinctly.
Handles unavailable usage as unavailable and redacts sensitive payloads before storage.

evals.prompt: Telemetry exports raw tokens, API credentials and full private reasoning. Metrics label every run ID. A successful final answer hides an earlier denied write. Design the corrected trace and an operator reconstruction test.
evals.expected_output: Privacy, cardinality and failed-trajectory evidence corrected.
expectations: Removes credentials/private reasoning and uses redacted evidence or bounded references.
Avoids run IDs as unbounded metric labels while retaining correlation in events.
Preserves the denied write and does not equate final answer success with a clean trajectory.
Defines a reconstruction check using observable events without re-executing live side effects.

evals.prompt: Add HTTP request duration and error counters to a normal web service. It has no models, tools, approvals or agent state.
expectations: Uses general observability without adding model-call or agent-trajectory events.
Does not require evaluator or approval infrastructure.

evals.prompt: Production support agent logs all retrieved IDs as citations and a quality=good event. Formal gold evals say 90%, live unsupported-evidence rate doubled, and an ad-hoc sample says fine. Design distinct signals and an action plan for unsupported evidence, tool errors, user overrides, safety breach, retry exhaustion, retrieval miss, latency/cost drift. Supply at least three concrete signal contracts; actual historical numeric baselines are unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-use joins and actionable honest signal definitions.
expectations: Separates formal eval metrics, production telemetry and ad-hoc diagnostics rather than treating them as interchangeable quality evidence.
Defines at least three signals with baseline or provisional baseline, threshold, window/denominator, severity and owner/response.
Distinguishes retrieved/visible/used support and proposes reconstructable decision/claim/evidence joins; no invented measured baselines.

evals.prompt: An audit found our agent approved a wrong refund, but our traces only contain one-line summaries of each model call and tool result. Redesign what the trace keeps so the auditor can see exactly what the model saw and what tools returned, without leaking customer card data.
evals.expected_output: Raw prompt/response artifacts retained safely and linked to events.
expectations: Retains the exact assembled model input and raw model and tool responses as artifacts linked by event ID, not only summaries.
Applies redaction before persistence and access control to those artifacts so card data is not stored or exposed.
Shows how the auditor reconstructs the wrong approval from these artifacts and events.
